alignments.note: The relative pronoun is rendered by the indefinite “some”; “on” realizes its accusative relation and rides with it.
The μέν of the μέν–δέ correlation has no distinct English realization; “some” is the relative pronoun’s own rendering.

The participle is rendered as a finite relative clause; “who” and “are in” are licensed helpers, and “doubt” is the meaning-bearing target head.
